desc:
Ecom Swift LLC does WooCommerce theme customization and edits: layout fixes, new shop templates and styling changes made in a child theme, so your store looks right and updates cannot undo the work.

## What are WooCommerce theme edits?

WooCommerce theme edits are targeted changes to the look and layout of your store's theme: spacing, fonts, product page structure, cart and checkout styling, filters, headers and footers. They are narrower than a full redesign. You name what looks wrong or what you want added, and we change those things and nothing else.

## Why a child theme matters

Many store owners edit their theme directly, and it works until the next theme update replaces the files and erases every change. A child theme solves this by keeping your changes in a separate layer that sits on top of the main theme. The parent theme can update for security and compatibility, and your edits remain.

Edits made without testing carry a second risk. A style rule that looks harmless can hide a button on a phone or push the payment box out of view. Because the cart and checkout are the most sensitive pages in a shop, every change must be checked with an order.

## How small layout details affect orders

Shoppers notice friction even when they cannot name it. A product title that wraps awkwardly, an Add to cart button that falls below the fold on a phone, a variation selector that is hard to tap or a filter sidebar that covers the products all make buying slower.

Improving these details lets visitors find, choose and pay with less effort. Product badges and tabs can place delivery, sizing or care information exactly where the question arises. We cannot promise a change in sales from a layout edit, but removing clear points of difficulty gives the store a fairer chance to convert the visitors it already has.

## What good theme work includes

- A child theme created if your store does not have one.
- Layout and spacing fixes on product pages, tested on phone and desktop.
- Typography and button styling made consistent across the shop.
- Cart and checkout styling that stays readable and keeps every field visible.
- Shop grid and filter styling that suits your number of products.
- New page templates, such as a landing page or a category layout.
- Custom product badges and tabs for details like sizing or shipping.
- Unused styles and leftover code removed, so pages stay light.
- A short template guide for anyone who will edit the store later.

## How we work

We begin with your list of changes, with screenshots if you have them. We set up a child theme if needed and make the edits on a staging copy where your host provides one. We check the pages on a phone and a computer, then place a test order to confirm the cart and checkout still work.

Only after that do we apply the changes to the live shop. The Basic package covers a short list of fixes. Standard extends to more fixes, a reworked product page layout, cart and checkout styling and shop grid styling. Premium handles a larger list, new templates, badges and tabs, cleanup of unused styles and a guide for your team.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Send screenshots and mark exactly what looks wrong.
- Use a child theme for every code change.
- Test on both a phone and a computer.
- Keep a copy of the theme settings before changes.

**Avoid:**
- Editing the parent theme files directly.
- Pasting random code snippets from forums into the theme.
- Hiding elements with styles when they should be removed properly.
- Changing the checkout flow itself when a style fix would do.

## Who this is for

This service suits an owner whose theme looks nearly right apart from a few annoying details, a shop that needs one or two new page layouts that the theme does not provide, and a business whose earlier edits keep disappearing after theme updates. It also suits a seller who wants a sticky Add to cart bar or a row of trust badges.

## What we need from you

Send the store address, your theme name and a list of the changes with screenshots. We need an administrator user, and hosting access as an invited user if you want us to work on a staging copy. We never need your password. If you want changes to how checkout works rather than how it looks, tell us early so we can scope it.
